title: Chemistry Calculations
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: CHEMISTRY CALCULATIONS
versions.note: validated payload. 21 consistent pointers; normal end marker; original and 3 audio variants byte-identical; not execution-tested
versions.unavailableReason: Another recovered save; the site offers one selected player.
versions.startupSource:
0 GOTO 10
1 S(1)=S(1)+2D-16
2 PRINTS(1),
3 GOTO 1
10 DEFDBL A-H,J-Z
20 FOR I=1TO2:READ C(I),CM(I),CP(I):NEXTI
30 FOR I=1TO2
40 M(I)=CM(I)-C(I)
50 S(I)=CP(I)-CM(I)
60 SW=32.06
70 SM(I)=S(I)/SW
80 MG(I)=M(I)/SM(I)
